metadata.scope: All retained premium response models accounted; coverage denominator is the full Taipei StopOfRoute reference.

field_semantics.ServiceTag: 服務日標籤(0: 周末weekend; 1: 平日weekdays)

metadata.pair_policy: Only exact ordered adjacent StopID pairs in source array order; repeated pairs are ambiguous. Sequence is retained but never used to infer alignment or an offset.
metadata.pair_evidence_resolution: For each pair source_rows_by_premium_instance group, premium_instance_id resolves through premium_models.json.gz to source_id and source_model_number (one-based). source_inventory.json resolves source_id to output_file; records[source_model_number-1].travel_times[source_row_number-1] retains original interval/RunTime/Sequence. usable_numeric_window_row_numbers is an ordered subset, never a reindexed or inferred row.
limitations: 版本不同可造成同一模型部分站對不相鄰或ID缺列；不以Sequence偏移、名稱或StationID補配。
ServiceTag 0為周末，1為平日；不是完整法定假日日曆。有效期與來源UpdateTime原樣分開保留。
匹配只證明所列原時段有發布估值，不是全日、三年歷史或實際當日旅行時間。
首站null起站列不構成站對；null RunTime不是0，來源明示0另列。
未取用、來源明示無資料、模型/服務日/站對未發布及ID不支援分開，均不能解讀停駛。
保留原始站序、迴圈及上下客碼；有行駛時間不等於端點可上下客。premium未提供業者，不按業者複製或加總模型。
各來源模型及有效期獨立，不選最新值或合併為單一完整班次；相同站對多次出現不按Sequence任配。
metadata.grain: one frozen retained source population and full reference denominator
